title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. translated_abstract: 收集和标注用于人体活动识别（HAR）的惯性测量单元（IMU）数据成本高昂，且在某一组受试者上训练的模型往往难以泛化到未见过的个体。即使数据是平衡的，分类器仍然难以区分动态特征相似的活动类别，因此可以从有针对性的数据增强中受益。我们探索在预训练生物信号编码器Bio-PM的表示空间中生成的合成IMU数据能否作为一种实用的数据增强来源。我们不直接合成原始信号，而是利用Bio-PM的冻结编码器将10秒的IMU数据窗口转换为token嵌入序列，并在此空间中训练类条件解码器：（1）一种按顺序预测token的自回归transformer解码器，以及（2）一种通过去噪目标学习token分布的扩散解码器。我们通过分布性指标和嵌入分析来评估生成数据的真实性。
tldr: 该论文提出利用预训练生物信号编码器Bio-PM的冻结编码器将IMU数据转换到token嵌入表示空间，并通过自回归transformer解码器和扩散解码器两类类条件解码器生成合成IMU数据，作为人体活动识别中提升泛化能力的实用数据增强方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes generating class-conditional synthetic IMU data by mapping IMU windows into the token embedding space of a frozen pretrained biosignal encoder (Bio-PM) using both an autoregressive transformer decoder and a diffusion decoder, serving as a practical augmentation approach to improve generalization in human activity recognition.
